why_best: Establishing the entire linear process before singling out the foundational phase creates an immediate mental map of where this specific metric lives within the wider system.
why_bad: Jumping directly to a solitary focal card without demonstrating its position in the broader sequence destroys the visual hierarchy required for enterprise reporting.
trap: Failing to hold absolute static clarity during the rest state before the dismiss phase will cause the viewer to miss the contextual balance of the full pipeline.
